content.title: Performance Progression | Base Loop to Advanced Skills
content.summary: Use one continuous base movement as the connective loop, escalate through increasingly difficult skills, assign each camera position a single proof role, then return to the same base loop after the peak.

quick_start.input_format: Continuous basic movements + 3 advanced skills + different functional positions each time + continuous rhythm/contact sounds + return to basic movements
quick_start.recommended_input: The maintenance drone maintains stable cruising with basic movements, sequentially completing narrow gap side flight, rotation scanning, and high-speed docking; using different camera positions to demonstrate each skill, returning to the same cruising rhythm after reaching the peak.
required_anchors: At least three skills progressively increase in difficulty
Each camera position is responsible for demonstrating only one skill
Return to the base cycle after reaching the peak
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Continuous basic movements are connected to advanced skills step by step. Each camera position only proves one movement, and returns to the basic cycle after the peak.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Start inside one continuous base motion and make it the mandatory entry and exit for every distinct skill. Increase difficulty across countable stages, assign each camera angle a verification purpose such as contact, clearance, rotation or recovery, combine learned principles near the end, then perform one peak variation and visibly return to the unchanged base loop.

invariants.rule: Begin mid-loop and keep the base motion active between every skill.
invariants.ablation_failure: Static resets turn the piece into disconnected highlights.

invariants.rule: Every skill must depart from and visibly return to the loop.
invariants.ablation_failure: Cuts can otherwise hide failed transitions.

invariants.rule: Increase difficulty through distinct movement properties.
invariants.ablation_failure: More of the same move adds speed but not progression.

invariants.rule: Give each camera angle one proof job.
invariants.ablation_failure: Decorative angle changes can obscure mechanics.

invariants.rule: After the peak, return to the original loop without stopping.
invariants.purpose: Closes the structure and proves control.
invariants.ablation_failure: A freeze at the peak abandons the connective rule.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original subject or system whose identity remains stable.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One visible variable that changes in countable causal stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained behavior rule that makes the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A coherent information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: One clean physical or graphic consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: A new hierarchy of diegetic cues supporting state changes.
